idea: How to prevent bathroom pipe problems
title: 3 Simple Habits to Prevent Bathroom Pipe Leaks and Clogs
description: Preventing costly bathroom plumbing issues comes down to routine maintenance and smart habits. Periodically check underneath your vanity cabinet for subtle moisture or mineral crust around P-trap slip-joint nuts, and hand-tighten any loose connections. Always fit sinks and shower drains with hair strainers to prevent organic buildup from binding with soap scum inside your branch lines. Avoid flushing anything other than toilet paper—wipes, cotton swabs, and hygiene products do not break down and quickly cause sewer backups. If a drain slows down continuously or emits odors, have a professional plumber clear the line before a complete blockage occurs.
